Each change is relative to the immediately preceding year, and there are no other changes. What is annual revenue at the end of year three, in millions of dollars?
instances.spoken_text: A product business asks for revenue after three specified annual moves. Initial annual revenue is four hundred and ninety million dollars. follow_up.question: Why should the growth percentages not simply be added?
follow_up.reference: Each percentage applies to the revenue level reached after earlier changes. Compounding captures those changing bases, including the interaction between increases and decreases.
